name: PT Champ Resto Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Champ Resto Indonesia Tbk operates as a restaurant chain company in Indonesia. It engages in the operation of GRILLMAN, a Korean and Japanese restaurant; Gokana Ramen & Teppan, a full-service Japanese restaurant; Raa Cha Suki & BBQ, a self-service concept; Monsieur Spoon, a French artisan brand; and Dewata, which serves Indonesian food. The company also operates CROCO, a bakery café; BMK, which serves traditional Indonesian menus; Chopstix, which serves Asian fusion cuisines; and Platinum Resto & Café, which serves comfort food.
